name: ChuSinGura 46+1 Kanade Hon-ChuuShinGura Hen
original_name: ChuSinGura46+1 -忠臣蔵46+1- 假名手本忠臣蔵編
source:
This is a sound novel by Rain Dog depicting the events of Chuushingura, where 47 ronin  sought revenge for the death of their master, Asano. The twist here is the protagonist Suguha falls into a time slip and ends up in the Edo period, and the ronin are mostly girls.

[Taken from Micchi's [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/08/01/august-2011-eroge-releases/]blog[/url]]
translation:
Rain Dog製作的有聲小說，講述《忠臣藏》中47名浪人為主君淺野之死復仇的故事。不同之處在於，主角すぐは意外穿越時空來到江戶時代，而浪人大多變成了女孩。

[譯自Micchi的 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/08/01/august-2011-eroge-releases/]部落格[/url]]
